title: Design: A/P Unpaid Invoices at 1440 px shows every column, as pictured
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} has an unpaid bill at {Location-B}; vendor {Vendor-B} has unpaid bills at {Location-A}; both have long names.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-62 Abadi Diesel Repair and {Vendor-B} is ZZAUTOTEST D-62 Adams Diesel Repair.
  • Starting screen: A/P Unpaid Invoices (Reports, then "A/P Unpaid Invoices" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu; the page title reads "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report") is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu in light theme at 100% zoom, with every group expanded.
  • The design picture "A/P Unpaid Invoices at 1440: every column visible" (ar-ap-p6-a-p-unpaid-invoices-at-1440-every-column-visible.png) is attached to this case and open beside the browser at 100% zoom; compare the layout, labels and styles, not the names and amounts, which are only examples.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look for a sideways scroll bar under the table.
  2. Read the column headings.
  3. Compare {Vendor-A}'s bill row with the picture.
  4. Compare {Vendor-B}'s rows with the picture.
  5. Compare the group rows and the subtotal rows with the picture.
  6. Widen the browser window to 1536 px and look across the page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: there is none: every column fits at 1440 px.
  • Step 2: the chevron, "Date" with a small up arrow, "Location", "Transaction Type", "No.", "Vendor Name" (no arrow), "Due Date", "Past Due", "Amount", "Open Balance", none wrapping.
  • Step 3: its number is plain text (a bill at another location) and the vendor name wraps onto a second line.
  • Step 4: their numbers are blue links.
  • Step 5: each group row: a blue chevron, the bold name and count; under each group "Total for " and the vendor's name with bold sums.
  • Step 6: nothing overlaps, is cut off or clipped; the layout is the same as at 1440 px.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header), story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can), story SV-11538 (Story 8, Report descriptions and layout)

  • S8-R3: “The headline column (Open Balance; Total on the Summaries) is pinned to the right edge and bold on the header, every row, every expanded row and the Totals row, as on Sales By Customer. At 1440 pixels wide every column of all six reports is visible without scrolling sideways: the customer or vendor name and Transaction type wrap long values onto a second line, Location wraps only on A/P Detail (nine columns), column headings never wrap, and money, date and number columns never wrap. Narrower than 1440 pixels, the table scrolls sideways under the pinned column.”
  • S7-R6: “A bill at the user's current location opens its delivery, as today. A bill at another location shows as plain text, because the bill page cannot switch location.”
  • S7-R1: “A document number is a link only when the user has the permission to open it and can open it in its own location; otherwise it shows as plain text.”
  • S2-N1: “On A/P Unpaid Invoices, the Vendor Name header is not clickable, because every group holds a single vendor and sorting by it could never change the order.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 6 "Descriptions and pinned column" (board Layout.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p6-a-p-unpaid-invoices-at-1440-every-column-visible.png: figure "A/P Unpaid Invoices at 1440: every column visible" (This build (after)), board "6. Report descriptions and the pinned headline column"
  • ar-ap-p6-a-p-detail-scrolled-sideways-light.png: figure "A/P Detail scrolled sideways, light" (Production (before)), board "6. Report descriptions and the pinned headline column" (today's look, for comparison only)

The design's own words:

  • "At 1440 pixels every column fits without sideways scrolling: Date, Location, Transaction Type, No., Vendor Name, Due Date, Past Due, Amount and the pinned, bold Open Balance. Group labels span to the total; text columns wrap. S8-R3." (caption of "A/P Unpaid Invoices at 1440: every column visible")
  • "No description anywhere; no column stays in place." (caption of "A/P Detail scrolled sideways, light")
